messages.author: 929e733ff7821ad3
messages.subject: spatial random slope
parts:
Dear Inla team,

I have a mixed model as below, which contained a correlated random intercept and random slope (for x) per sampling station. Since my stations are distributed spatially and I would like to further extrapolate the spatial information, I would like to construct the model in INLA using GMRF. However, I am wondering how I can construct the random slope of x per location in INLA? does anyone has any hints on syntax?
 glmmTMB(y~ x +  (1+ x | station), data=dat)

Thanks very much

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] spatial random slope
parts:
we do not support this (..|..) notation, but you have to do that on the
index level. there is a spesific model that would simplify this, see

inla.doc("intslope")

and the example therein
